Look at what our compromised institutions are doing to our country. The Punjab and Haryana High Court has just granted regular bail to an individual booked under national security provisions and the Official Secrets Act. This person was allegedly in telephonic contact with a Karachi-based handler known as “Punjabi Kuri.” 

Instead of enforcing absolute loyalty to the nation and protecting our borders, the court has decided that the mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with someone across the border in Pakistan is not enough to keep them behind bars. This is pure judicial weakness that undermines our national sovereignty and disregards the safety of our citizens. We are coddling those suspected of compromising our security, eroding the authority and firm hand required to keep our homeland safe. Without law and order, we are simply inviting chaos.
